goal: Every reader that finds or reads a plan by its place in a repository goes through one module, `src/mc/plan-source.js`, which alone knows the layout `docs/project/<programme>/<project>/PLAN.json`. Plans are still read from origin/main and from a step worktree exactly as today. This is the first half of moving plans out of the repositories (ruling 48, `docs/project/mc/mc-project.md`); the second half changes only this module.

success_criteria.criterion: `src/mc/plan-source.js` holds the plan layout, and `listPlans`, `listProgrammes`, `findMainPlan`, the runner's `planOf`, `tidy`'s facts and `helperGround` use it. `helperGround` lists PLAN.json plans.
success_criteria.check: `node --test --import ./tests/_isolate-home.mjs tests/mc/plan-source.test.js tests/mc/brief-collect.test.js tests/mc/helper-turn.test.js tests/mc/status-project.test.js tests/mc/run.test.js tests/mc/tidy.test.js tests/architecture/plan-paths.test.js` passes.

success_criteria.criterion: No file under `src/mc/` outside `plan-source.js` gains a literal `'PLAN.json'` or `'PLAN.md'`: the count per file is a ratchet.
success_criteria.check: `node --test tests/architecture/plan-paths.test.js` passes, and `grep -c "'PLAN\.json'\|'PLAN\.md'" src/mc/brief-collect.js src/mc/status-project.js src/mc/helper-turn.js src/mc/tidy.js` prints 0 for each.

steps.title: plan-source.js: the plan layout in one module
steps.done_when: `src/mc/plan-source.js` exports `PROJECT_DIR`, `PLAN_FILE`, `LEGACY_PLAN_FILE`, `planPath`, `parsePlanPath`, `lsTreeArgs`, `plansInTree`, `projectNames`, `findPlan` and `planIn`, `tests/mc/plan-source.test.js` covers each, and `mc gate tests/mc/plan-source.test.js` is green.
comments: src/mc/plan-source.js is the one module that knows the plan layout: PROJECT_DIR, PLAN_FILE, LEGACY_PLAN_FILE, planPath, parsePlanPath, lsTreeArgs, plansInTree, projectNames, findPlan (the body of findMainPlan, with git passed in) and planIn (the body of planOf, with list/exists/read passed in). No caller changed yet: findMainPlan in status-project.js and planOf in run.js still carry their own copies, for step 2 to point at findPlan and planIn. helperGround and listPlans are step 1's sibling in step 2 of the project, not here.

Correction to the note above: the sentence about helperGround and listPlans was wrong. Those two readers move in step 2 (listPlans, listProgrammes, helperGround through plan-source.js), not in step 1, and step 1 changes no caller.

steps.title: listPlans, listProgrammes and the helper's ground read through plan-source
steps.done_when: `listPlans` and `listProgrammes` in `src/mc/brief-collect.js` use `plan-source.js`, `planRecords` is exported from `brief-collect.js`, `helperGround` lists PLAN.json plans through it, `listPlansOnMain` is gone, the tests in `tests/mc/brief-collect.test.js` and `tests/mc/helper-turn.test.js` pass, and `mc gate` is green.
comments: listPlans and listProgrammes read through plan-source.js; planRecords is the per-project loop of listPlans, exported from brief-collect.js. helperGround lists PLAN.json plans as well as PLAN.md through plansInTree and planRecords, so the intake turn now sees current plans; listPlansOnMain is gone. Verified: mc gate on the four affected test files (73 tests green) and the full mc gate (3050 tests green). Success criteria are not marked met: they belong to the last step.

steps.title: mc status, the runner's planOf and tidy read through plan-source
steps.done_when: `findMainPlan` delegates to `findPlan`, `planOf` in `src/mc/run.js` to `planIn`, `tidy.js` takes its `ls-tree` arguments and plan directory from `plan-source.js`, `tests/mc/status-project.test.js`, `tests/mc/run.test.js` and `tests/mc/tidy.test.js` pass unchanged, and `mc gate` is green.
comments: steps[2]: findMainPlan now delegates to findPlan (status-project.js), the runner's planOf delegates to planIn (run.js; readPlanText dropped from run.js's import as it had no other use there), and tidy's origin/main ls-tree and fallback plan directory come from lsTreeArgs and planPath (tidy.js). Behaviour is unchanged: findPlan and planIn carry the same matching, the same first-match order and the same legacy PLAN.md report. No test was changed. Verified: mc gate on tests/mc/status-project.test.js, tests/mc/run.test.js and tests/mc/tidy.test.js is green (293 tests), and the full mc gate is green (3050 tests, 0 failed, 9 skipped). The ratchet check for brief-collect, status-project, helper-turn and tidy belongs to steps[3]; the plan's success criteria stay met: false until then.

steps.title: A ratchet: the plan file's name stays in plan-source
steps.done_when: `tests/architecture/plan-paths.test.js` passes on this tree and fails when a new `'PLAN.json'` literal is added to any other file under `src/mc/`, both success criteria are `met: true`, and `mc gate` is green.
comments: plan-source step 4: tests/architecture/plan-paths.test.js is the ratchet on 'PLAN.json' / 'PLAN.md' literals under src/mc/ (outside plan-source.js). ALLOWED at the time: merge-boundary.js 3, plan-merge.js 1, page-render.js 1, run.js 2. Those are the readers that go when plans leave the repositories; a row is lowered or deleted when its file stops naming the plan file. The ratchet only stops a count rising. Bite-checked with a literal in tidy.js. Both success criteria met; criterion 0's check 346/346.
